6817.title: Unbounded plugin detail pane prevents scrolling
6817.rootCauseOneLine: The plugin detail root grows inside a bounded block panel slot, leaving its inner scroll container without a scroll range while the host clips it.
6817.proposedFix: Constrain the shared plugin detail root to its containing height and retain the existing scroll owner; verify long details and configuration with the attached real-browser regression.
6817.caveats: Verified twice using trusted source on Linux Chrome, not native macOS or third-party plugin code. Short forms that fit do not expose the failure.
